Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (plant 7546) lists generator 4, 60.5 MW, combustion turbine, 2003 as operating with no planned retirement. The permit memo from April 2019 at https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/4608.pdf shows no retirement plan. No sale or mothballing was found in a web search.

Backup Power.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists the plant as an electric utility plant, and the Oklahoma Department of Environmental Quality memo from April 2019 at https://applications.deq.ok.gov/permitspublic/storedpermits/4608.pdf describes it as an electricity generation plant with diesel emergency generators as separate equipment. So the value of no stands.

units.notes: No retirement, mothballing or owner change was found.
